wtt_time.reference_split: same-date train.h5; deterministic 1024 rows, labels never used for adaptation
wtt_time.query_split: same-date test.h5; labels only after terminal prediction

awf.reference_split: first 1024 deterministic query rows as unlabeled support; transductive diagnostic, not strict confirmation
awf.query_split: remaining query rows; labels only after terminal prediction
awf.label_policy: intersection of site names across source and five query files; 190 common classes

model.direction_adapter: pad/truncate direction sequence to 5000; construct positional 2x1800 sign histogram TAM; no packet magnitude or timestamp values
model.checkpoint_selection: terminal epoch 45; no target-date labels or tuning

adaptation.proteus: source CE + feature MMD + entropy/diversity + GMM pseudo-label fine-tuning, fixed low-lr port; no target-label use
adaptation.no_pseudo_fixed: source CE + feature MMD + entropy/diversity, fixed lr and tracked BN update; no pseudo-labels
adaptation.selection: terminal update 800; no query labels, no early stopping

permissions.wtt_future_query_labels: post-hoc exposed diagnostic scoring; not independent confirmation

decision.primary: report all five conditions by dataset/slice; no pass threshold transferred from TemporalDrift
decision.claim_boundary: external transferability/development evidence; WTT future and AWF remain exposed diagnostic unless a separate confirmation audit permits otherwise
